summary: Poisson upper limits and intervals were bisected on [0, 500] without checking the bracket, so a root beyond 500 came back as 500.

database_specific.introduced_basis: the defective lines are in the repository's first commit, the 0.3.0 import; earlier releases are not in this repository
database_specific.fixed_basis: 0.4.0 was released (merge 9870a35, version 0.4.0) without a release tag or manifest

observables: Poisson upper limits and central (Garwood) intervals (poisson_diagnostics.py upper-limit and interval; the limits in likelihood_limits.py and statistical_toys.py)
impact.bias: limits and interval ends clipped at a mean of 500: central_interval(490) gave an upper end of 500.0 (Garwood, 68.27% central: 513.15), upper_limit(495, 0) gave 500 (533.19)
impact.trigger: counts of a few hundred or more, where the limit or the interval end exceeds 500

remedy: recompute limits and intervals with a release that has the fix (0.4.0 or later); a value of exactly 500 is the clipped one
